newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Nearly 65 pct Russia-London Club debt reconciled.
newsitem.headline: Nearly 65 pct Russia-London Club debt reconciled.

text.p: Russia has fully reconciled almost 65 percent of its debt to the London Club of commercial bank-creditors, a senior Finance Ministry official said on Wednesday.
"The amount of fully reconciled debt is coming close to 65 percent," Deputy Finance Minister Mikhail Kasyanov told Reuters.

Kasyanov, speaking after a meeting between the Finance Ministry, London Club representatives and Vneshekonombank, the state's agent for debt reconciliation, said the ministry would provide more information on Thursday.
He denied market talk that Russia intended to ask the London Club to cut the threshhold of fully reconciled debt necessary to close the restructuring agreement.
"There was and there is no intention to review any terms or conditions agreed with the Banking Advisory Committee in financial proposals," he said.
Russia has to reconcile $24 billion in principle of $35 billion total debt, inherited by Russia from the Soviet Union after its breakup, to close the agreement.
